b16537693.desc:
Brought to you by Driven Properties, this 1 Bedroom Apartment is located in Bunyan Tower, Bunyan Tower, Dubai Marina. 

Enjoy stunning Marina views from this bright and inviting one-bedroom apartment in Bunyan Tower, perfectly positioned in the heart of Dubai Marina. 

The apartment offers a comfortable layout with beautiful waterfront outlooks that create a relaxing atmosphere throughout the home. Residents benefit from one of the Marina's most convenient locations, with Dubai Marina Metro Station practically connected to the building, making daily travel simple and efficient. 

The famous Marina Walk is just steps away, providing endless options for dining, entertainment, shopping, and leisure along the waterfront. Bunyan Tower is ideally located beside both the entrance and exit points of Dubai Marina from Sheikh Zayed Road, ensuring quick access in and out of the community. 

Adding even more value, the rent is fully inclusive, covering Wi-Fi, chiller charges, electricity, water, and standard utility bills. This combination of Marina views, unbeatable connectivity, and all-inclusive living creates an exceptional opportunity to experience the very best of Dubai Marina.

Brought to you by Driven Properties, this 1 Bedroom Apartment is located in Bunyan Tower, Bunyan Tower, Dubai Marina. 

Experience elevated Marina living in this highly desirable corner one-bedroom apartment in Bunyan Tower. Benefiting from a corner layout, the apartment enjoys additional natural light, enhanced privacy, and impressive Marina views from multiple angles, creating a bright and spacious atmosphere throughout. 

Located immediately beside Dubai Marina Metro Station, residents enjoy direct access to public transport and seamless connectivity to major business districts and attractions across Dubai. Marina Walk is only a short stroll away, offering a vibrant waterfront lifestyle surrounded by restaurants, cafés, retail outlets, and leisure facilities. 

Bunyan Tower's exceptional position at the main entrance and exit of Dubai Marina via Sheikh Zayed Road provides a significant advantage for daily commuting, allowing quick and convenient access without navigating deep into the Marina. T
